correctness.rationale: PASS: For n>=2 and 1<=k<=n-1, a signed subset is independent of (k+1)-face hyperedges precisely when its support meets at most k antipodal pairs. Projection to the (k-1)-simplex skeleton has a positive-vertex section, with section∘projection contiguous to identity; hence it is a B_n-equivariant homology isomorphism even though the section itself is not equivariant. The augmented simplex chain complex over Z is exterior powers of E_n with contraction by coordinate sum; its top skeleton cycles are wedge^k U_n, with no lower homology/torsion. Signed combinatorial Alexander duality on the ambient 2n-vertex set twists by the ambient vertex-permutation sign: each pair-block permutation is even, each sign flip is odd, giving eta. Integral UCT yields H_{2n-k-2}(Theta;Z)=Z_eta⊗(wedge^k U_n)^* and vanishing otherwise. The coefficient formula for traces follows from the exterior-power determinant. For k=1,n>=3, modulo any prime p|n the root lattice U_n mod p has the all-ones invariant, whereas its weight dual quotient has no invariant, proving integral nonisomorphism though rationalizations agree. Checked n=2 and endpoint k=n-1 in the universal construction; finite character/lattice verifier is only a corroborating check, not proof of the infinite theorem.
